title: REPUBLIC BANCORP INC /KY/ 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: Republic Bancorp, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 24, 2026, disclosing the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on April 23, 2026. All 13 director nominees were elected to the Board, and the appointment of Forvis Mazars, LLP as the company's independent registered public accounting firm for fiscal year 2026 was ratified. This is a routine corporate governance filing with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Republic Bancorp held its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders on April 23, 2026
All 13 director nominees were elected to serve until the 2027 annual meeting
A. Scott Trager received the most withheld votes (2,353,447) among director nominees
Mark A. Vogt received the second-most withheld votes (2,518,280) among director nominees
Forvis Mazars, LLP was ratified as the independent auditor for fiscal year ending December 31, 2026
The auditor ratification vote passed with 35,141,356 votes for, 16,037 against, and 12,647 abstained
